findings.highlight: his life was full of blessedness.
findings.evidenceJa: 控えめに言っても、それは幸福よりだったろう
findings.governingReading: After saying he changed many people’s fates, the narrator judges those changes as at least tending toward happiness, then confirms his struggle was not wasted.
findings.explanation: The fortunate direction of rescued lives becomes the hero’s blessed life.

findings.highlight: He had friends and a lover.
findings.evidenceJa: 仲間らしきモノもいたし、恋人らしきモノもいた
findings.governingReading: The narrator twice qualifies the relationships with らしきモノ, retaining distance from unequivocal labels.
findings.explanation: Companion-like and lover-like presences become definite friends and a lover.
